tooltips.rfm_status: Reduced Functionality Mode (RFM) occurs when Full Disk Access is disabled. The sensor runs with limited capabilities but still communicates with CrowdStrike cloud.
tooltips.full_disk_access: Full Disk Access (FDA) is required for proper sensor function. Without FDA, the sensor enters RFM and cannot access the file system for threat detection.
tooltips.system_extension_approved: System Extension approval is required for kernel-level components. The sensor needs both the main agent extension and network filter extension to function properly.
tooltips.network_filter_active: Network Filter extension provides traffic filtering and monitoring capabilities. When active, it can inspect network traffic and detect network-based threats.
tooltips.web_filter_active: Web content filtering capability status. This extension enables web-based threat detection and content filtering.
tooltips.cloud_connected: Cloud connection status shows if the sensor can communicate with CrowdStrike cloud services over TLS port 443 for threat intelligence and updates.
tooltips.sensor_active: Sensor Active status indicates the Falcon sensor is running and functioning properly. Inactive sensors may have installation or configuration issues.
tooltips.heartbeat_active: Heartbeat shows the sensor is actively communicating with CrowdStrike cloud. Sensors send heartbeats every two minutes to confirm connectivity.
tooltips.service_management: Service management configuration status. Ensures the sensor starts automatically and runs persistently on the system.
tooltips.team_id_valid: Team ID validation confirms the sensor uses a valid CrowdStrike identifier for proper system extension approval and policy delivery.
tooltips.global_status: Global Status provides an overall health assessment considering system extensions, Full Disk Access, cloud connectivity, and sensor functionality.
tooltips.uninstall_protection: Uninstall Protection prevents unauthorized sensor removal. When enabled, it requires a maintenance token for uninstallation or configuration changes.
tooltips.sensor_versions: Sensor version distribution shows deployed Falcon sensor versions across your environment. Keeping sensors updated ensures latest threat detection capabilities.
tooltips.system_extensions: System Extensions are kernel-level components required for endpoint protection. The sensor needs both main and network filter extensions to function effectively.
